6.8.rationale: The Indonesian provisions cited (Pasal 12(1) huruf b on facilitating access/legal consultation; Pasal 13(4) on legal protection for women who are witnesses/victims of violence and discrimination) do not create a distinct intersectional category of “women involved in legal processes” as a targeted vulnerable group; they are general service/protection measures for women/victims. If the indicator intends explicit recognition of women in legal proceedings (e.g., detainees, defendants, women in custody, or specific procedural accommodations), this regulation does not clearly provide that. Therefore the judge’s “Yes” seems to stretch the indicator, and the golden “No” appears consistent with the Indonesian text.
